title: A Atlas for the Clock
author: Paloma Brightwater
blurb: Zephyrine Nakamura, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the century turns.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
